items.title: Uber stock drops as bookings guidance disappoints; CEO bets on robotaxi push to grow overall business
items.summary: Uber reported second-quarter results on Wednesday that beat on bookings and profit, but shares fell as the ride-hailing giant's bookings guidance missed analyst projections. Uber says its robotaxi push is still well underway, with investments set to grow.

items.title: SpaceX’s $1T Goal and 3 More Shockers From Musk on the Earnings Call
items.summary: SpaceX  and  Tesla  CEO Elon Musk is famous for his sky-high ambitions, including reaching Mars one day.  After SpaceX’s earnings report Tuesday, Musk laid out four more brazen goals for the rocket and artificial-intelligence company, including reaching $1 trillion in revenue in less than five years.  SpaceX stock tumbled 8% to $115.29 on Wednesday, while the S&P 500 edged up 0.1%.
